narrative.overview: Khalid explicitly selected the supplied Riviera 1.1.0 handoff and confirmed app-wide colors, fonts and shared component styling with existing layouts, wording, Iconsax and real metrics retained. [Riviera source and implementation mapping](branding/riviera/README.md) supersede conflicting older palette, font, pure-black-sidebar and panel-border statements below. Warm ivory canvas, warm-white surfaces, honey actions and olive-charcoal navigation carry the brand. Fraunces550 titles, Manrope UI and DM Sans metadata are self-hosted OFL fonts. The exact191 tokens are exported centrally; old application roles resolve to them rather than maintaining independent palettes. Panels are quiet/borderless; controls, focus and essential dividers keep visible boundaries. Approved V3 and later owner-requested geometry remain the layout family, not the old colors. The desktop rail collapses to a 72px implementation proposal, keeps every destination accessibly named, and reuses the login villa/palm line art; global search remains available in the rail and responsive header. No sample chart allocations, icon-family switch, business copy or backend change is authorized. ENERGY1 / RHYTHM1 / MOTION1. Human visual review is separate.
keyCharacteristics: Supplied Riviera palette and licensed local fonts on existing CRM compositions.

dos: Do consume shared Riviera semantic roles through Tailwind and existing components.
Do preserve French labels, Iconsax, live scoped values and accessible states.
Do keep the exact verified runtime font versions and original OFL notices.
donts: Don't convert reference sample people, allocations or counts into application data.
Don't use categorical pipeline fills as semantic feedback colors.
Don't infer human product acceptance from technical or finish-review evidence.
